admin.title: Admin Platform
admin.subtitle: Review arena reports and manage ladder accounts on this device.
admin.listFail: Could not load reports. Try again.
admin.processFail: Could not process report. Try again.
admin.confirmApproveBody: This clears the reported nickname and/or avatar on the public ladder and marks the report resolved.
admin.confirmRejectBody: This closes the report without changing the user's public identity.

userOps.title: Ladder user tools
userOps.hint: Look up a student by email or UID. Remove clears the public ladder and avatar files but keeps Auth/Pro and upload quotas. Delete erases Auth + cloud data.
userOps.lookupFail: Lookup failed. Check the query and try again.
userOps.lookupNotFound: No Auth user found for that email/UID.
userOps.blockedSelf: You cannot target your own account.
userOps.confirmRemoveBody: Deletes public preview, shard entries, and avatar files. Auth login, Pro, and upload quotas stay intact.
userOps.confirmDeleteBody: Erases Auth + cloud data. This cannot be undone.
